controls: Incomplete predecessor reaches bounded timeout/review_required with no cash snapshot, seal, authorization or launch; no waiting result is treated as completion.

Ready path order is inspect -> exact original service inactive -> completion proof -> cash status -> retain cash -> seal -> copy previously explicit grant into exact prepared proposal -> launch. A second run is rejected by the consumed intent/result and launch count remains one.

waiting_process_limits.reason: Avoid inheriting an unverified2GiB hard address-space cap into the final cold grader verification child.

reviewed_single_launch_guard: Atomic exclusive write_new(INTENT) occurs before waiting/sealing; launch separately refuses an entered coordinator identity.
